snippet.title: The Buddha Lived 80 Years. Here They Are in 100 Seconds 🪷 | Gautama Buddha's Life
snippet.description:
A prince who was never allowed to see a sad thing sees four, walks out of his palace at night, starves for six years, and wakes up under a tree.

The killer who couldn't catch a walking man, the rice pudding that ended six years of starving, the string that snaps when it's too tight... and why you are carrying his first talk in your wallet right now.

Which part did you not know? Tell us in the comments 👇

snippet.description:

An absolute intense, high-stakes WWE Championship main event on Friday Night SmackDown! 😱 On the August 26, 2004 edition of WWE SmackDown, "The Deadman" The Undertaker stepped into the squared circle to challenge Orlando Jordan—who was defending the WWE Championship on behalf of his injured Cabinet leader, JBL!

With the richest prize in sports entertainment hanging in the balance, the tension inside the arena reached an electric fever pitch! Orlando Jordan utilized explosive athleticism, relentless speed, and desperate dirty tactics to survive The Deadman's wrath, while The Undertaker unleashed bone-rattling heavy strikes, Old School rope walks, and devastating Chokeslam and Tombstone threats! With a battered JBL watching closely from ringside and waiting for the perfect moment to strike, the chaos exploded into pure Ruthless Aggression drama! Watch until the very end to see the dramatic title near-falls, shocking ringside interference, and the explosive climax that shook the entire blue brand! 💯

snippet.title: [이슈] 포퓰리즘 역풍에 '전쟁 수준' 증시 폭락 맞은 인도네시아…"수십조 원 이탈 우려, 패닉 상태"/2026년 11월 23일(월)/KBS
snippet.description:
인도네시아 통화 가치가 외환위기 수준으로 폭락하고 있습니다.

루피아 가치는 심리적 저지선인 달러당 1만 8천 선까지 내주며 사상 최저 수준으로 떨어졌습니다. 

종합주가지수가 연초 대비 40% 넘게 빠지고, 외국인은 투매에 나서는 등 증시도 '전쟁 수준'으로 폭락했습니다.

프라보워 정부의 포퓰리즘 정책이 역풍을 맞았다는 지적이 나오는 가운데 대통령 지지율은 급락하고, 반정부 시위도 거세지고 있습니다.
